description: Add or edit a sketch dimension. On a saved contour reopened by open_feature or sketch_edit the gesture stays live in the sketch (result live: true, written: false) and the confirm or sketch_commit writes it with the contour. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: sketch_dimension
